authorization.method: AuthorizedCode header verified on main public-facing website

engagement.scope_summary: Full-scoped vulnerability assessment on all assets attributable to the business.
constraints: No destructive techniques (DDoS, malware spreading, social engineering, phishing, credential stuffing, password spraying, brute force, MFA bypass, lateral movement, evasion).
No testing of third-party owned infrastructure.
No actions against other devices in the local network.
Minimum proof-of-concept only; stop after proof is obtained.
No sensitive data exfiltration or disclosure.
engagement.notes: Owner authorized broad discovery; find as many vulnerabilities as possible on in-scope assets.
